justification: IP-compliance copy fix: the consumer report pages (canibuildit surface) exposed internal product codenames — 'Threat Radar', 'Pre-DA Site History', 'Granny Flat Yield Predictor', 'Flood Truth' — in page titles, nav labels and metadata, which the blog-content IP rule bans from any public page. Renamed to the factual public names already used on the info site. Standard tier: string-literal copy only, no logic/data/DB change, route slugs unchanged.

pre_impl.existing_data: canibuildit.com.au rewrites to /reports (already PlotDetect-branded). The tiles + tool-page metadata carried internal codenames. Factual public names reused verbatim from the info-site reports section shipped this session (Development Monitoring, Granny Flat Feasibility, Overshadowing, Solar potential, Flood Risk, Prior Development Activity).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The 'rebrand' was a near-non-issue (brand already consistent); the real finding was a systemic IP-rule violation (internal names public). Route slugs (/reports/threat-radar etc.) are intentionally KEPT — display name is decoupled from URL per the info-site decision, so no link/SEO breakage.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new components; pure rename of user-facing string literals. Verified no code identifiers (imports/components/types) were touched.

functions: N/A — copy-only rename across report page string literals; no functions changed.

break_it.scenario: A rename accidentally changes a route slug or component name, breaking a link or the build
break_it.what_happens: would 404 a tool or fail the build
break_it.how: replacements targeted string literals only; hrefs (/reports/<slug>) left unchanged; grep confirmed no import/component/type identifier was altered
break_it.repro: grep the diff for import/function/const identifiers among the renamed strings -> none

break_it.scenario: A banned internal codename survives somewhere on a public report page
break_it.what_happens: a banned internal codename stays visible on a public consumer page, breaching the IP rule
break_it.how: full-tree sweep post-change returns zero matches for Threat Radar / Pre-DA Site History / Shadow Ambush / Solar Yield Underwriter / Granny Flat Yield Predictor / Flood Truth across app/reports/
break_it.repro: grep -rnE 'Threat Radar|Pre-DA Site History|Flood Truth|Granny Flat Yield Predictor' app/reports/ -> empty

break_it.scenario: A rename leaves awkward/wrong public copy (e.g. lowercased 'flood screening Report')
break_it.what_happens: a homeowner sees awkward or lowercased copy that reads as unfinished on a public page
break_it.how: the generic 'flood screening' substitution was corrected to the consumer name 'Flood Risk' in every title/label; only one code comment retains the generic phrase
break_it.repro: grep 'flood screening' app/reports/ -> only the code comment remains

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — load canibuildit.com.au: confirm the 7 tiles show factual names (Development Monitoring, Granny Flat Feasibility, Overshadowing Check, Rooftop Solar Potential, Prior Development Activity, Flood Risk Check, Bushfire Pre-Screen), the nav labels match, and each tool page title/metadata carries no internal codename.
